form.label: CIM Data Model Audit — Web, Network Traffic, Endpoint, DNS
form.description: Eight audit panels: raw-field candidate indexes and actual data-model field cardinality. Candidates are hints, not proof of CIM eligibility. All results use the selected time and accessible indexes. DC = distinct count; filled = events with a non-null field; pct = filled/events × 100. CIM placeholders such as unknown and - can count as populated; inspect these before accepting a mapping. src is the client/source address; source is Splunk log-source metadata. A DC of 1 is a review cue, not proof of a fault. Raw discovery requires existing field extractions and cannot discover unparsed fields. Run this in the same app context as your detections. Start with 60 minutes; all-index raw discovery and exact DC over long periods can be expensive.

input.label: Index name or wildcard (e.g. *, nginx, web*)
Data-model search mode
input.choice: Acceleration summaries only — faster, may be incomplete

search.query: index=$index_pattern|s$ NOT index=_* NOT index=notable NOT index=risk NOT index=summary | fields * | eval audit_src=coalesce(src,src_ip,srcip,SourceIp,SourceIP,source_ip,source_address,CLIENTIP,clientip,c_ip,'c-ip',srcaddr), audit_dest=coalesce(dest,dest_ip,dstip,dst,DestinationIp,DestinationIP,destination_ip,destination_address,DESTIP,server_ip,dstaddr) | eval audit_web_fields=null(), audit_network_fields=null(), audit_endpoint_fields=null(), audit_dns_fields=null() | foreach * [ eval audit_web_fields=if(match("<<FIELD>>", "(?i)(^|[._-])(url|uri|uri_path|uri_query|request_uri|request_url|http_url|http_uri|cs_uri_stem|cs_uri_query|cs-uri-stem|cs-uri-query|request_path|url_original|original_url|url_path|url_query)$|^(Durl|RequestUrl|RequestUri|ClientRequestURI|ClientRequestPath|csUriStem|csUriQuery)$") AND mvcount(mvfilter(isnotnull('<<FIELD>>') AND len(trim('<<FIELD>>'))>0 AND '<<FIELD>>'!="-"))>0, mvappend(audit_web_fields, "<<FIELD>>"), audit_web_fields) ] | foreach * [ eval audit_network_fields=if(match("<<FIELD>>", "(?i)(^|[._-])(src_port|dest_port|dst_port|sport|dport|srcport|dstport|source_port|destination_port|transport|protocol|proto|ip_proto|bytes|bytes_in|bytes_out|sentbyte|rcvdbyte|packets|packets_in|packets_out)$") AND mvcount(mvfilter(isnotnull('<<FIELD>>') AND len(trim('<<FIELD>>'))>0 AND '<<FIELD>>'!="-"))>0, mvappend(audit_network_fields, "<<FIELD>>"), audit_network_fields) ] | foreach * [ eval audit_endpoint_fields=if(match("<<FIELD>>", "(?i)(^|[._-])(process|process_name|process_exec|process_path|process_id|process_guid|parent_process|parent_process_name|parent_process_path|command_line|commandline|image|newprocessname|parentimage|targetfilename|file_name|file_path|filename|filepath|registry_path|registry_key_name|registry_value_name|targetobject|service|service_name|service_path|servicename|imagepath|exe|execve)$") AND mvcount(mvfilter(isnotnull('<<FIELD>>') AND len(trim('<<FIELD>>'))>0 AND '<<FIELD>>'!="-"))>0, mvappend(audit_endpoint_fields, "<<FIELD>>"), audit_endpoint_fields) ] | foreach * [ eval audit_dns_fields=if(match("<<FIELD>>", "(?i)(^|[._-])(query_type|record_type|reply_code|reply_code_id|qname|qtype|rcode|query_name|dns_query|dns_question_name|dns_response|dns_answer|dnsquery|queryname|queryresults|querytype)$|^DNS\\.(query|answer|src|dest)$") AND mvcount(mvfilter(isnotnull('<<FIELD>>') AND len(trim('<<FIELD>>'))>0 AND '<<FIELD>>'!="-"))>0, mvappend(audit_dns_fields, "<<FIELD>>"), audit_dns_fields) ] | eval audit_web=if(mvcount(audit_web_fields)>0,1,0), audit_network=if(mvcount(audit_network_fields)>0 AND isnotnull(audit_src) AND isnotnull(audit_dest) AND audit_src!="-" AND audit_dest!="-",1,0), audit_endpoint=if(mvcount(audit_endpoint_fields)>0,1,0), audit_dns=if(mvcount(audit_dns_fields)>0 OR (match(sourcetype,"(?i)dns|named|bind|resolved") AND isnotnull(query)),1,0) | stats count AS raw_events sum(audit_web) AS web_candidate_events values(eval(if(audit_web=1,sourcetype,null()))) AS web_sourcetypes values(eval(if(audit_web=1,audit_web_fields,null()))) AS web_fields dc(eval(if(audit_web=1,audit_src,null()))) AS web_src_dc dc(eval(if(audit_web=1,audit_dest,null()))) AS web_dest_dc sum(audit_network) AS network_candidate_events values(eval(if(audit_network=1,sourcetype,null()))) AS network_sourcetypes values(eval(if(audit_network=1,audit_network_fields,null()))) AS network_fields dc(eval(if(audit_network=1,audit_src,null()))) AS network_src_dc dc(eval(if(audit_network=1,audit_dest,null()))) AS network_dest_dc sum(audit_endpoint) AS endpoint_candidate_events values(eval(if(audit_endpoint=1,sourcetype,null()))) AS endpoint_sourcetypes values(eval(if(audit_endpoint=1,audit_endpoint_fields,null()))) AS endpoint_fields dc(eval(if(audit_endpoint=1,audit_src,null()))) AS endpoint_src_dc dc(eval(if(audit_endpoint=1,audit_dest,null()))) AS endpoint_dest_dc sum(audit_dns) AS dns_candidate_events values(eval(if(audit_dns=1,sourcetype,null()))) AS dns_sourcetypes values(eval(if(audit_dns=1,audit_dns_fields,null()))) AS dns_fields dc(eval(if(audit_dns=1,audit_src,null()))) AS dns_src_dc dc(eval(if(audit_dns=1,audit_dest,null()))) AS dns_dest_dc BY index

panel.title: Web — Candidate indexes from raw fields

html.p: Indexes with extracted URL/URI/path/query fields, including IIS/vendor variants. A URL in an unrelated event can be a false positive; validate HTTP/proxy/WAF semantics before mapping. Candidate totals are heuristic and are not a data-model coverage percentage.

search.query: | where web_candidate_events>0 | eval candidate_pct=round(100*web_candidate_events/raw_events,2) | rename web_candidate_events AS candidate_events web_sourcetypes AS candidate_sourcetypes web_fields AS evidence_fields web_src_dc AS raw_src_dc web_dest_dc AS raw_dest_dc | table index raw_events candidate_events candidate_pct raw_src_dc raw_dest_dc candidate_sourcetypes evidence_fields | sort 0 - candidate_events

panel.title: Web — Data-model field audit by index

html.p: Actual Web.Web results, grouped only by index so missing field values do not remove indexes. Each audited field has DC, filled event count and filled percentage. An absent index means no matching results in the selected range/mode, not necessarily no raw logs.

search.query: | table index events source_dc sourcetype_dc url_dc uri_path_dc uri_query_dc src_dc dest_dc http_method_dc status_dc http_user_agent_dc user_dc app_dc site_dc url_filled url_pct uri_path_filled uri_path_pct uri_query_filled uri_query_pct src_filled src_pct dest_filled dest_pct http_method_filled http_method_pct status_filled status_pct http_user_agent_filled http_user_agent_pct user_filled user_pct app_filled app_pct site_filled site_pct | sort 0 - events

panel.title: Network Traffic — Candidate indexes from raw fields

html.p: Indexes with source + destination and port/protocol/byte evidence. Review event meaning before applying network/communicate tags; src/dest alone is insufficient. Candidate totals are heuristic and are not a data-model coverage percentage.

search.query: | where network_candidate_events>0 | eval candidate_pct=round(100*network_candidate_events/raw_events,2) | rename network_candidate_events AS candidate_events network_sourcetypes AS candidate_sourcetypes network_fields AS evidence_fields network_src_dc AS raw_src_dc network_dest_dc AS raw_dest_dc | table index raw_events candidate_events candidate_pct raw_src_dc raw_dest_dc candidate_sourcetypes evidence_fields | sort 0 - candidate_events

panel.title: Network Traffic — Data-model field audit by index

html.p: Actual Network_Traffic.All_Traffic results, grouped only by index so missing field values do not remove indexes. Each audited field has DC, filled event count and filled percentage. An absent index means no matching results in the selected range/mode, not necessarily no raw logs.

search.query: | table index events source_dc sourcetype_dc src_dc dest_dc src_port_dc dest_port_dc transport_dc action_dc app_dc bytes_dc bytes_in_dc bytes_out_dc direction_dc user_dc src_filled src_pct dest_filled dest_pct src_port_filled src_port_pct dest_port_filled dest_port_pct transport_filled transport_pct action_filled action_pct app_filled app_pct bytes_filled bytes_pct bytes_in_filled bytes_in_pct bytes_out_filled bytes_out_pct direction_filled direction_pct user_filled user_pct | sort 0 - events

panel.title: Endpoint — Candidate indexes from raw fields

html.p: Indexes with process, file, registry or service fields. This does not imply all Windows/Linux events belong in Endpoint; review each endpoint dataset separately. Candidate totals are heuristic and are not a data-model coverage percentage.

search.query: | where endpoint_candidate_events>0 | eval candidate_pct=round(100*endpoint_candidate_events/raw_events,2) | rename endpoint_candidate_events AS candidate_events endpoint_sourcetypes AS candidate_sourcetypes endpoint_fields AS evidence_fields endpoint_src_dc AS raw_src_dc endpoint_dest_dc AS raw_dest_dc | table index raw_events candidate_events candidate_pct raw_src_dc raw_dest_dc candidate_sourcetypes evidence_fields | sort 0 - candidate_events

panel.title: Endpoint — Data-model field audit by index and dataset

html.p: Processes, Filesystem, Services, Registry and Ports. One row per index/dataset/field to keep the dataset-specific fields readable. Events are per dataset; do not sum them as unique Endpoint events. Empty fields remain visible as DC 0 / filled 0.

search.query: | table index dataset events field distinct_count filled_events filled_pct source_dc sourcetype_dc | sort 0 index dataset field

panel.title: Network Resolution (DNS) — Candidate indexes from raw fields

html.p: Indexes with DNS-specific query/type/response fields, or a DNS-like sourcetype and query. Generic domain or URL fields alone are not treated as DNS evidence. Candidate totals are heuristic and are not a data-model coverage percentage.
